_comment: Single place to configure the release workflow (.github/workflows/release.yml). nodeVersion is the Node.js used for release builds. packageTypes: 'type' is passed to `npm run dist:<type>`; 'runner' is the GitHub-hosted runner that builds it (an rpm/exe/dmg may need another OS, so every type has its own runner); 'extensions' are the output file extensions to publish; 'verify': 'deb' makes staging check the .deb Version field against the derived version. Types must also have a dist:<type> script in package.json.
